units.source_text: 在牢房里，让人深切感受到被囚禁滋味的，不是铁门，不是墙壁，而是那个小小的窥视孔。

en.t: In a prison cell, what makes a person feel the taste of captivity most deeply is not the iron door or the walls, but that small peephole.

units.source_text: 男人一阵惊慌失措，迅速搜索了一下记忆仓库。

en.t: The man was seized by a moment of panic and quickly searched through the storehouse of his memory.

units.source_text: 水平分割开来的天空与黄沙……哪里都没有建设瞭望塔的余地。

en.t: The sky and the yellow sand were split apart horizontally... nowhere was there any room to build a watchtower.

units.source_text: 从这里望不见什么，自然会觉得那边也望不到这里。

en.t: Since nothing could be seen from here, it was only natural to think that this place could not be seen from over there either.
